description_text:
The artificial spinal disk is a weight-bearing modular implant consisting of two endplates and one polyethylene inlay and is intended as an alternative to fusion. It's designed to allow controlled motion at the surgery level.In artificial disk replacement, worn or damaged disk material between the small bones in the spine (vertebrae) is removed and replaced with a synthetic or artificial disk. The goal of the procedure is to relieve back pain while maintaining more normal motion than is allowed with some other procedures, such as spinal fusion.

Of the mysteries of the pyramid, perhaps the most fascinating is the unparalleled preservation effects of the Great Pyramid. It was found that animals which died in this pyramid never decayed, but rather perfectly dehydrated to a mummified state. It was then found that scale models can preform this same feat! This can and has been repeated and tested. In other words, the mysterious forces which are brought about in Egypt can be experimented with using this array of scale models.
This package deal contains two files, one array of 25 pyramids and one with 144, both contain solid (not hollow) pyramids which are perfect scale models of the Great Pyramid of Giza (as they stood before destruction). The pyramids in the 12x12 array are half of the size of those pictured in the 25 pyrmaid array, the smaller pyramids proved to be more effective in testing. Les Brown and Patrick Flanagan have published research on the effects of these grids. Based on numerous independent tests, the grids are more efficient at passive energy reception from the environment than large pyramids. This energy has been called many things through the ages such as orgone, tensor energy, subtle energy, odenforce, etc. 
These can be used in experiments with plant growth, water enhancement, razor sharpening, food dehydration, and many more!There are two fields emitted by this device, that of the positive and negative polarity (yin and yang). This energy exists all around the device, so control plants should be placed well away. This is designed to be oriented with the faces perfectly facing the various magnetic poles (as much as possible). Permanent magnets can also be used to do away with orientation.
I recommend this to be printed using multi jet fusion, which is offered by many online 3D printing fulfillment services.For research purposes only.

The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world.  We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! Spinal cord cross section 3d printable models and FDM friendly.
The model depicts the following parts: the white and gray matters, the filaments on ventral and dorsal root, the spinal ganglion, the dorsal and ventral roots, the dorsal ramus and the rami communicantes.
Please note that some amplification has been introduced to show the small details of the model.
Three versions of the model are offered: ( a solid without the vertebrae stand ), ( a solid with the vertebrae stand ) and ( a fragmented model with individual parts )                                       
The vertebrae stand has 4 point of contact to ensure that the model stands upright.
Please note that some gluing will be necessary to assemble the model.
A clearance of 0.35mm is modeled into the splitted parts to ensure the clearance for assembly.
Size 230mm*150*150mm. ( to be scaled as you wish ) 
Made in solidworks 2020.
The model is provided in three formats : STL, STEP, IGES and OBJ.
The model has been simplified and optimized for 3d printing.
To be used for educational purposes and 3d printing applications.
Ideal for use in medical teaching environments.
Please contact us for any inquiries and modifications.

description_text: Serpulids are a family of marine polychaete worms, belonging to the order Serpulida, known for their unique calcareous tubes. These tubes are typically coiled, spiral, or sometimes even straight, and are made from calcium carbonate, which the worms secrete to form a protective and supportive structure. Serpulids attach their tubes to various substrates, such as rocks, shells, coral reefs, or even man-made structures like piers and ship hulls.These worms are sessile, meaning they remain fixed in one location throughout their lives. They extend a crown of tentacles, known as the radiolar crown, from their tubes to capture plankton and small organic particles from the water column for feeding. The tentacles are covered in cilia that create water currents to facilitate the collection of food.Serpulids are important to marine ecosystems in several ways. Their calcareous tubes contribute to the structure of habitats, helping to form complex environments that provide shelter and protection for other small marine organisms. By stabilizing sediments and promoting the growth of other organisms, serpulids play a role in the ecological dynamics of coral reefs and other marine communities.

description_text: Mesohippus was a small, three-toed prehistoric horse that lived during the late Eocene to early Oligocene epoch, around 30 to 40 million years ago. Roughly the size of a medium dog, Mesohippus stood about 2 feet (60 cm) tall at the shoulder and had longer legs and a more developed brain than its predecessors. It lived in forested environments of North America, feeding on soft leaves and vegetation. As one of the key transitional species in horse evolution, Mesohippus offers a clear link between ancient, dog-sized herbivores and the powerful single-toed horses of today.

These materials simulate accurate light interaction, including matte finish on bone surfaces, subtle reflection on curved areas, and shadow depth across crevices.

description_text:
This asset is a high-detail 3D model of birch pollen (Betula spp.), created for scientific visualisation, SEM-style rendering, and macro-scale CGI. The morphology is based on real pollen structure and intended for accurate visual representation rather than stylised interpretation. While the model remains recognisably CGI at extreme magnification, it offers substantially higher fidelity than most pollen assets currently available and provides a strong base for artists with post-production or compositing workflows. Preview renders use minimal image processing, limited to a simple curves adjustment.
The model was created in Autodesk 3ds Max and refined in ZBrush. It is fully UV unwrapped and designed to support both physically based and microscopy-inspired rendering pipelines. All primary texture maps are supplied at high resolution to preserve surface detail in close-up renders.
Included texture and data maps
8K albedo / diffuse map
8K roughness map (RGB)
Tangent-space normal map (RGB, linear)
Multiple 32-bit EXR height maps for displacement at different intensities
High-frequency bump map for surface nodules
Low-frequency bump map for overall form and falloff
Procedural material components for Autodesk 3ds Max users
All non-colour data is supplied in linear space (gamma 1.0) for physically correct rendering.
This model is suitable for scientific illustration, educational and medical content, allergy-related visualisation, microscopy-style renders, and high-end macro CGI. A separate version optimised for 3D printing is available for users requiring physical output.

description_text:
Stylized Skeleton Character Pack is a modular fantasy character asset created in a cartoon style.The pack includes one skeleton body, 9 different stylized skulls, and 9 pairs of separate eye meshes for easy customization.
Each skull has slightly different topology and triangle count, allowing visual variety while maintaining consistent style across the project. Eyes are provided as separate meshes, so you can easily replace them with your own or adjust size and placement per character.
Textures for the body and skulls are provided in 2K resolution, while eyes use compact 256px textures. The asset uses PBR Metallic/Roughness workflow with Base Color, Normal, and Roughness maps. Normal maps are optional and can be enabled or disabled depending on your preferred look.
Eye glow is implemented directly in Blender using shader nodes, allowing quick control over emissive color and intensity without re-exporting textures.
All parts are delivered in T-pose with no rig or shape keys, making the asset suitable as a base for your own rigging setup.
Perfect for games, stylized renders, fantasy scenes, or character prototyping.

Donald Duck for 3D Printing Stl.Files: STL, OBJ, ZTL.STL one-piece. STL of various detailing.PERFECTLY DETAILED.
Donald Fauntleroy Duck is a cartoon character from the Walt Disney studio: a white anthropomorphic drake with a yellow beak and yellow paws.He first appeared on May 3, 1934 in the cartoon short The Wise Little Hen, but in the short Donald's Happy Birthday his birthday is March 13. Donald has a twin sister, Della Thelma Duck, and nephews, Huey, Dewey and Louie Duck (Della's sons). Mother - Hortense Duck (McDuck) (sister of Scrooge McDuck, his uncle), father - Quackmore Duck. From the very beginning until 1983, Clarence Nash was the voice of Donald.According to Leonard Maltin's The Chronological Donald - Volume 1, Donald was created by Walt Disney when he auditioned Clarence Nash reciting Mary Had a Little Lamb in his duck voice. Mickey Mouse had already become a key model for children at that time, and Disney wanted a character that had several negative qualities that Mickey could no longer add.Donald first appeared in The Wise Little Hen on June 7, 1934 (he was also mentioned in a 1931 Disney storybook). Donald's original appearance was created by cartoonist Lundy and was similar to his modern appearance. The feathers and color of the beak were the same as the blue sailor's shirt and cap, but his beak was longer, his body was plumper, and his feet were smaller. Donald's character was not shown; in the short he played the role of the useless friend from the original story.Bert Gillette, director of The Wise Little Hen, used Donald in the Mickey Mouse cartoon The Orphan Concert (August 11, 1934). Donald was one of the characters who performed shows for the orphans. Donald's hot temper stayed with him for a long time.Donald was still popular with viewers. This character began to appear in most Mickey Mouse cartoons along with Minnie Mouse, Goofy and Pluto. For example, in the 1935 cartoon “The Band Concert,Donald appears several times, trying to ruin the concert. And in the 1937 cartoon “Lonesome Ghoststhe team is Mickey Mouse, Goofy and Donald Duck.In 1936, the artists made some adjustments to Donald; he became slimmer and more handsome. After this, Donald began to appear in cartoons as the main character. On January 9, 1937, the cartoon “Don Donaldwas released, entirely dedicated to him. On April 15, 1938, the cartoon Donald's Nephews appeared, in which nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie appeared for the first time. That same year, Donald overtook Mickey Mouse in the ratings. After Fred Spencer's death in 1938, Don Towsley became the chief animator for the Donald Duck shorts from 1938 to 1948.More than one hundred episodes were filmed about Donald between 1941 and 1965.During wartime, the character was used to ridicule the Nazis. In one cartoon (Der Fuehrer's Face), Donald is German and works at a defense plant under Nazi compulsion. He has to salute the portraits of Hitler, Mussolini and Hirohito. At the end of the episode, the viewer realizes that Donald dreamed everything that happened. The credits roll against the backdrop of Donald admiring the Statue of Liberty. The cartoon received an Academy Award in the Animated Short Film category.In most post-war cartoons, Donald Duck is presented as a loser and a bungler. Donald appears in educational films and television shows - Donald in Math or How to Get Injured on the Job in 1959.Donald was always easy to spot with his famous voice. The last time Clarence Nash, who is considered Donald's father, voiced his character was in the cartoon Mickey's Christmas Carol in 1983. After Nash's death in 1989, Donald was voiced by Tony Anselmo.In the TV series DuckTales, Donald was given a minor role; he appeared in only a few episodes. TV viewers can only see Donald on his own TV show, where, in addition to Donald, his grown-up nephews, Daisy Duck and other residents of Duxburg participate. This is the cartoon Quack-Bryak.Donald was mentioned in the TV series Darkwing Duck, episode Get Off the Screen. But the hero himself dressed up as Donald in the Descending Star series. They considered Donald a screen star (and even confused Darkwing Duck with him).Throughout his career, Donald has proven more than once that he doesn't like Mickey Mouse and wants to become Disney's number one star. If in the first series of cartoons Mickey and Donald were friends (“Boat Builders, later the relationship between them became worse and worse (“Symphony Hour. Finally it came to open confrontation. For example, in 1988, a cartoon was released where Mickey Mouse was kidnapped, and the main suspect in the kidnapping was Donald Duck. However, the charges were eventually dropped due to insufficient evidence.On Donald Duck's 50th birthday, Walt Disney gave his character a huge cake, commenting, It's even bigger than the one I gave Mickey Mouse.While cartoons about Donald are extremely popular in America, in Europe Donald Duck is better known as a comic book hero. Collections of Donald Duck comics are published weekly all over the world, all of them are reissues of the American version of Inducks comics.Comics about Donald Duck were drawn by various artists, but the most famous of them is Don Rosa, who began working in the “duck genrein 1987. The first character Don Rosa drew was Lucky Gladstone, the exact opposite of Donald Duck. Don Rosa drew comics about Donald, he is also the creator of most of the comics about Scrooge McDuck.Donald Duck is the only cartoon character who has become a symbol of the university. American University in Oregon entered into an agreement with the Walt Disney Company to use Donald's image. The university's athletic teams consider Donald Duck to be their mascot, and Donald's fiftieth birthday was attended by all of the university's students, each wearing a sailor suit and cap. Donald's image is used by various brands, including orange juice manufacturers.In 1988, Donald appeared in the film Who Framed Roger Rabbit, produced by Touchstone Pictures and Amblin Entertainment. In this film, Donald appears in the same frame with another duck character - Daffy Duck, with whom he has a conflict while playing the piano.The rights to Donald Duck have often become the subject of litigation. The story with Carl Christensen, the author of comics about the duck Arne from Sweden, received the greatest resonance. Walt Disney sued him, claiming that Christensen's character was too similar to Donald. The Swedish artist was not at a loss and subjected his hero to plastic surgery, after which he began to resemble a crow with a long beak.On August 9, 2004, Donald Duck's star was laid on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

A pair of 3d-printable Menger Sponge fractal blocks.  
Produced with a constructive solid geometry process.  
The smaller block is ~36k polys, the larger block is ~673k polys. 
The smaller block is proportionally smaller than the larger one as shown. 
stl, obj, ply formats 
The Menger sponge is a fascinating three-dimensional fractal shape that exemplifies the concept of self-similarity and is created through a recursive process of dividing and removing sections from a cube. While it may seem simple at its core, the Menger sponge becomes increasingly complex as you iterate this process, generating a structure with infinite surface area but zero volume.
3D printing a Menger sponge can be a challenging endeavor due to several reasons:
Intricate Structure: As the iterations increase, the Menger sponge's structure becomes incredibly intricate with many tiny details. This complexity poses challenges in terms of print resolution and precision.
Fragility: The smaller the iterations, the more fragile the resulting structure can become. Delicate features and thin walls can easily break during the printing process or when handling the finished object.
Support Material: Printing the Menger sponge often requires substantial support structures to prevent overhangs and ensure stability. Removing these supports without damaging the intricate structure can be labor-intensive.
Print Time: Creating a high-resolution Menger sponge with many iterations can be extremely time-consuming. The printer needs to navigate a large number of layers, slowing down the overall printing process.
Material Usage: Printing a Menger sponge with many iterations can consume a significant amount of material, especially if you're aiming for a large, detailed model.
Despite these challenges, 3D printing a Menger sponge can be a rewarding project for those interested in fractals and complex geometries. It serves as a great test of a 3D printer's capabilities and a demonstration of the fusion of mathematics and technology in the world of art and design.

This 3D printable model of the human digestive system is created with anatomical accuracy and realistic proportions, making it an excellent choice for medical education, biology training, scientific demonstrations, or anatomical displays.
The model includes the key components of the digestive tract: esophagus, stomach, liver, small intestine, large intestine, and rectum, providing a lifelike external representation of the complete human digestive system.
The mesh is fully solid, watertight, and optimized for 3D printing, ensuring reliable results on FDM, SLA, and SLS printers. The model can be easily scaled up or down without loss of detail, making it suitable both for compact teaching models and large exhibition pieces.

King Tutankhamen (or Tutankhamun) ruled Egypt as pharaoh for 10 years until his death at age 19, around 1324 B.C. The tombs vast hoard of artifacts and treasure, intended to accompany the king into the afterlife, revealed an incredible amount about royal life in ancient Egypt, and quickly made King Tut the worlds most famous pharaoh.

description_text:
Digital Lip Bumper (Orthodontics) The Lip Bumper Appliance is a removable device that aids in the distalization of the lower molars. Each bumper is customized to allow an even force from the lip muscle to effectively create space for continued treatment of overcrowding. A lip bumper is a dental appliance used in dentistry for various purposes. Lip bumpers are often used in orthodontic treatment plans when the patient has crowded maxillary or mandibular teeth in the arch. A lip bumper is used to hold the lower molars back while allowing the lower front teeth to move forward. This proves space for overcrowded teeth. The bumper keeps the lower lip out of contact with the lower front teeth. Simultaneously, it places a force on the back teeth which prevents them from moving forward. It is commonly an alternative to teeth extraction
A lip bumper is a wire which is partially coated in plastic and slides into two metal molar bands at either end. When in place, it lines the front side of the lower teeth. It removes pressure from the lip and cheek by essentially stretching or widening the arch of the lower jaw. Every time the wearer talks, laughs or smiles, the lip pushes against the bumper opposed to the teeth.This push from the device also prevents the permanent molars from sliding forward as the primary teeth are lost and permanent teeth erupt. Because of this, lip bumpers are most effective if they are used before all of the primary teeth are lost.http://www.odlortho.com/product/lip-bumper/ This device is designed in 3Shape Appliance and realistically rendered plus KeyShot Pro.

description_text:
Digital Anti-snoring Mouthguard Snoring simply occurs when the muscles relax, constricting  the airway temporarily. When breathing the movement of air causes the muscles  to vibrate resulting in noise.  This  condition has no effect on oxygen levels getting to the your lungs. Most people  who snore have learnt not to let this affect their sleep, however, it usually has  an impact on their partners. Sleep Apnea is a more serious condition. There are different  levels of severity and occurs when the muscles relax and partially or  completely constricts the windpipe, thus cutting off your oxygen supply. This  can result in frequent episodes of totally obstructed breathing known as, Obstructive Sleep Apnea.Source:https://www.highoaksdentalpractice.com/anti-snoring.php
A medical sleep device digitally designed in 3Shape Appliance Designer and realistically rendered in KeyShot Pro5. This splint can be 3D printed or CNC milled as well.

description_text:
Digital Dental Tanner Splint (Orthodontics) 
A medical bite splint for bruxism and sleep issues.  As matter of the fact, Tanner' splints are used for the treatment of dysfunction of the'TMJ', muscle, control 'Bruxism' and 'Parafunctional' habits. Michigan splints was developed at Michigan University with the aim of creating neuromuscular harmony within the masticatory system to help with reducing parafunctional forces.The appliance is also called a 'Stabilisation' splint and provides balanced occlusion on the appliance that allows for smooth jaw movement by removing any interferences, and allows the condyles to seat in centric relation. Once balanced and fitted chair side, all of the opposing dentition will occlude with the splint with a bilateral contact of force at the same time, thus reducing the bite force that muscles generate and causing the muscle to relax.https://www.bremadent.co.uk/michigan--tanner-splints.html#/
This device is digitally designed in 3Shape Appliance designer & realistically rendered in KeyShot Pro5.

Digital Full Dentures Full dentures are full-coverage oral prosthetic devices that replace a complete arch of missing teeth. The following are indications for this type of dental prosthesis:

  - full arch of missing teeth

  - Dental implants that have been deemed inappropriate by patient and/or doctor because of financial constraints, a medically compromised status that contraindicates surgery, or inevitable damage to vital structures such as maxillary sinuses, nerves, and vesselsIntraoral cancer that has caused a loss of gross intraoral tissue, resulting in an edentulous dental arch; the complete denture prosthesis would then not only replace teeth but also fill in the portion of missing tissue (eg, nasopharynx, hard palate) . description_text:
Digital Space Maintainer Appliance (Orthodontics) 
A space maintainer is an orthodontic appliance that is used to hold a space that is left when a baby tooth falls out or it is removed prematurely. When a baby tooth is lost, and the adult tooth that will replace it is not developed or ready to erupt, the space will need to be held to ensure that the adult tooth has an appropriate place to grow. By placing a space maintainer, you can prevent teeth from shifting or drifting and becoming crowded out, malocclusions (misalignment of teeth), and other orthodontic conditions.Baby teeth may fall out on their own prematurely or be lost due to trauma or caries. Once a baby tooth has been lost or removed, a space maintainer will typically be placed soon after. This appliance will stay in place until the adult tooth is ready to erupt.https://www.corylissortho.ca/space-maintainers/                                             
This medical space maintainer appliance can be laser sintered or 3D printed. actually is digitally designed in 3Shape Appliance Designer and realistically rendered in Rhino3D and KeyShot Pro.

description_text:
Digital Removable Partial Denture FrameworkA removable partial denture (RPD) is a denture for a partially edentulous patient who desires to have replacement teeth for functional or aesthetic reasons and who cannot have a bridge (a fixed partial denture) for any reason, such as a lack of required teeth to serve as support for a bridge (i.e. distal abutments) or financial limitations. This type of prosthesis is referred to as a removable partial denture because patients can remove and reinsert it when required without professional help. Conversely, a fixed prosthesis can and should be removed only by a dental professional. Source:https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Removable_partial_denture
This appliance is designed digitally in 3Shape Dental System & rendered realistically in KeyShot 7.2.

description_text:
Digital Elastic Mandibular Advancement Appliance
The EMA (Elastic Mandibular Advancement) is a custom-made removable intraoral appliance created for noninvasive treatment of snoring and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The appliance is designed to both advance the lower jaw (mandible) and open the bite to allow for less restricted airflow during sleep.
EMA appliances help promote a deeper, more restful sleep by preventing snoring and relieving the symptoms of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The EMA does not interfere with breathing through the mouth, even in cases of congested nasal passages. The EMA has many options for patient advancement with 9 strap lengths and 4 different elastic tension options. Non-restricted side-to-side (lateral) or front-to-back (protrusive) movements of the jaw are possible while wearing the appliance due to varying elastic bands.

description_text: Digital Tanner RepositionerTanner Repositioner helps to minimize abnormal activity of the masticatory muscles by providing an ideal bite. Named after Dr. Henry Tanner, it is constructed for the lower jaw and is therefore not easily visible. The Tanner splint is useful for addressing pain upon waking in the masticatory muscles and the TMJ. With time, this splint results in programming the jaws to their natural position. While other stabilization splints are flat at the back and are used to increase the vertical dimension, the Tanner appliance has shallow depressions at the posterior region. Generally, the front teeth will not come in contact when the back teeth press together. This splint is usually prescribed by dentists for patients dealing with tooth mobility, recession, bruxism, periodontal disease, and tooth wear. It is normally worn at night and requires periodic monitoring and adjustments by the dentist. The patient may need to wear it for about 3 to 6 months for best results.https://dentagama.com/news/tanner-splintActually, this repositioner was designed in 3Shape Appliance Designer and realistically rendered in KeyShot Pro as well.

description_text:
The 3d model was created from computed tomography scans (CT medical data). It represents the first human cervical vertebra, also called the atlas.
The atlas, often written C-1 (from latin 'collum' - neck), is the most superior cervical vertebra. That being so, it is also the topmost vertebra of the backbone. It is connected to the occipital bone which forms the posterior part of the skull.The vertebra has the form of a ring. Its role is very important because together with C-2 vertebra (also known as the axis) it forms the atloaxoid joint that enables the head to turn in different directions.What’s more, it is different from the rest of cervical vertebrae. The atlas's specific anatomical feature lies in the fact that it has no vertebral body. An axial-loading force on the back of the head can cause the anterior and posterior arches of the vertebra to break. This type of injury is called the Jefferson’s fracture.
Patients's description: male, age 29
The model was created for educational use. Intends to help those interested in human anatomy and physiology during their learning process, as well as encourage other people deepen their knowledge about the human body.

description_text:
Sucrose is common table sugar. It is a disaccharide, a molecule composed of two monosaccharides: glucose and fructose. Sucrose is produced naturally in plants, from which table sugar is refined. It has the formula C12H22O11.
For human consumption, sucrose is extracted, and refined, from either sugar cane or sugar beet. Sugar mills are located where sugar cane is grown to crush the cane and produce raw sugar which is shipped around the world for refining into pure sucrose. Some sugar mills also process the raw sugar into pure sucrose. Sugar beet factories are located in colder climates where the beet is grown and process the beets directly into refined sugar. The sugar refining process involves washing the raw sugar crystals before dissolving them into a sugar syrup which is filtered and then passed over carbon to remove any residual colour. The by-now clear sugar syrup is then concentrated by boiling under a vacuum and crystallized as the final purification process to produce crystals of pure sucrose. These crystals are clear, odourless, and have a sweet taste. En masse, the crystals appear white.

description_text:
*Warning: The object needs to be dynamically balanced and/or to have the motor mounted on supports due to a physical oscillation which occurs at high RPM. Should be handled by qualified professionals.  *
This flwheel is designed to create a vortex in the contained water. This vortex sustains the rotational inertia by adhering to the inner surface thereby resisting the motion of being spun. When the flywheel is braked, the water moves centrifugally outward through the tubes and enters again tangentially to further sustain the vortex within the contained water. This allows for the flywheel to come to a complete stop and then for it to restart itself at a relatively high rotational speed  using the aforementioned surface adhesion of the spinning water vortex. Put another way, this transmission of force is similar to the action of a Tesla turbine. 
Inspired by Viktor Schauberger.

description_text:
INCOMPLETE
Photogrammetric model of Ceres, the largest of the Dwarf Planets.
When discovered, Ceres was considered a planet then was downgraded to being called an asteroid. Then recently, it was pulled back to its feet and given the proper distinction of Minor Planet.
Ceres resides in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter and holds roughly 1/3rd of the belt's mass. Crazy, right? Think of Star Wars and asteroid belts and there should be millions of cruise-ship sized rocks crashing into one another constantly but nope. In fact, the four largest bodies in the asteroid belt hold a little over half the stuff there. So I'm sorry, there are no giant asteroid-worms, there's just a planet that made people think it was an asteroid.
This obviously isn't a complete model, there are gaps because this is done with images from the higher-altitude HAMO orbits and some places weren't imaged well enough.
I'll updating it using imagery from the lower-altitude LAMO orbits and filling the poles soon. Once that's done, I'll move onto coloring it properly.
This model is created with 3DF Zephyr v4.302 processing 1152 images

Introduction & LoreSingularity Horizons was founded on the basis of creating better futures. The company places an emphasis on colonization and exploration as a means to expand humanity’s horizons. Singularity Horizons came to the market later than other popular spaceship manufacturers, so a niche design was needed. The first ship produced by Singularity Horizons was aptly named “Origin”. The first submodel “SPS” filled the niche of a Surface Plotting System. SPS is designed to fly over the surface of a new planet. The onboard systems will communicate with a mothership or other SPS ships to plot a map of the planet. Origin comes standard with everything needed for an extended planetary trip without infrastructure. This includes a toilet, refrigerator, storage space, bed, and a computer. The ship features four VTOL engines. Each VTOL engine is powered by 9 lift-producing power plants. The rear engine is used for space travel. While not the most beautiful ship, the Origin was designed to be a cheap “everyday man’s ship”. In a world where data is very valuable, the Origin model allows spacefarers to make a living with a reasonable investment.

This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a surgical nurse. The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - sufficiently clean

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.

However, after an incident where one was successfully used to repell and alien boarding party, the design was quickly militarized.  Now they are the standard in heavy shock troopers all across the southern arm of the galixy.  The Praefecti wade into battle ignoring torrents of fire that would cripple a battle tank. Command soldier in the center of the preview is not included, but is available as a gift in the makers cult welcome pack. https://www.patreon.com/themakerscultAdditional upgraded and accessories may be found for free on thingiverse.https://www.thingiverse.com/MatttKing/designs

This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built  3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This scan was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher within Zbrush.

The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of  architectural visualizations, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc.

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world.  We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us!

description_text:
This is a 3D print ready model. No non-manifolds.  The size of the model is X45mm Y63.4mm Z82.3mm but it can ofcoursebe scaled to any size to suit your printing purpose.
There is no sphenoid bone (the one on the base of the sull, behind the jaw) or smaller cavities in order to have a nicely printable model. The vertebrae have the holes for vertebral artery. The skull in piece assembly is slightly higher resolution and has added detail, like frontal bone foramen and nose foramen.
If the scaling is too small in your slicer when you open the file, just go to the scaling and change the 100% to 1000%, so it scales it up 10 fold. For some reason some slicers don't understand the scale correctly that has been created with blender.
There are 5 parts total: cervical spine, half skull, half head that is solid, half head that is hollowed, a single solid unit of head-skull-spine
The model can be printed in 3 ways:
1) As a unified whole model (single piece) that can be easily hollowed with a good slicer program, such as Chitubox
2) In parts with fitting slots, where the surface anatomy head model is solid, and can be hollowed with your slicer program 
3) In parts with fitting slots, Where the surface anatomy model is already hollowed, with a hole on the bottom for resin to leak out

description_text:
A Star Wars universe lightsaber from an Inquisitor. Printable in 6 different parts, with grip and guard. Modelled from a lightsaber in the game Star Wars - Jedi fallen order
History:The Inquisitorius, also known as the Inquisitorius Program, the Order of Inquisitors, and the Imperial Inquisition, was an organization of Force-sensitive dark side agents who served the Sith-ruled Galactic Empire. Members of the Inquisitorius were called Imperial Inquisitors, or simply Inquisitors, and were also nicknamed Red Blades. They were tasked with hunting down the remaining Jedi who had survived Order 66 at the end of the Clone Wars as part of the Jedi Purge, retrieving any children identified as force-sensitive, as well as other political dissidents. The Inquisitors were governed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who was the apprentice to the Galactic Emperor, Sheev Palpatine, and led by an individual known only by his title, the Grand Inquisitor.
Print one of every part, except the locating pin which you should print two of in order to align and fasten the blade guard properly.The fit is quite tight, so remember to check and calibrate your printer before printing. Sanding could of course solve the problem.
Total height: 414mm.Maximum height of individual part: 184mmWidth of handle: 44mm, so quite beefyNot much infill needed, it is up to you.Layer-height: I used 0.2mm, that might be a bit on the tiny side as it took many hours to print. The details are not critical on this so you could get away with 0.3 probably.

Currently, NASA supports the International Space Station (ISS) along with the Commercial Crew Program, and oversees the development of the Orion spacecraft and the Space Launch System for the lunar Artemis program.
NASA's science division is focused on better understanding Earth through the Earth Observing System; advancing heliophysics through the efforts of the Science Mission Directorate's Heliophysics Research Program; exploring bodies throughout the Solar System with advanced robotic spacecraft such as New Horizons and planetary rovers such as Perseverance; and researching astrophysics topics, such as the Big Bang, through the James Webb Space Telescope, the four Great Observatories, and associated programs. The Launch Services Program oversees launch operations for its uncrewed launches.

This 3D printed model represents a detailed cross section of the human ear, showcasing its intricate anatomy for educational and illustrative purposes. The model encompasses all essential components, providing a clear understanding of the ear's structure and function.
Detailed Anatomy:
Outer Ear (Pinna and Auditory Canal): Features a realistic depiction of the auricle (pinna) and the external auditory canal, highlighting the ear's role in sound collection and direction.Middle Ear: Includes the tympanic membrane (eardrum), malleus, incus, and stapes (ossicles), demonstrating their positions and connections.Inner Ear: Displays the cochlea, vestibule, and semicircular canals, illustrating the complex structures responsible for hearing and balance.
Notice: The images showcasing the model are not all real photographs. I have labeled the top left corner to indicate which images are real and which are digitally rendered. The purpose of the rendered images is to highlight the intricate details, especially if you plan to print them on a resin printer.
3D printing settingsThere are two versions of the ear model: one with a stand and one without. I have provided the model at its full width of 19 cm to showcase its details. While it can be printed at a smaller scale, this may cause issues with the Malleus part, which will become very small. It is recommended to print at the same scale or larger for optimal results.

description_text:
Mosasaurus is a 3d model of carnivore that lived in the Cretaceous period and inhabited Europe and North America.
Mosasaurs are very large extinct marine reptiles with some species reaching lengths of over 50 feet and are considered to be some of the fearsome predators to ever inhabit our oceans. They first emerged during the Cretaceous period 90 million years ago, and become the oceans dominant predators with the with the extinction of the ichthyosaurs and decline of plesiosaurs. Mosasaurs went extinct during the Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction event which killed all of the dinosaurs. Mosasaurs needed to eat in order to sustain their huge size. It’s likely that mosasaurs weren’t picky and would eat pretty much anything which could fit into their enormous mouths.
For aquatic fauna, wildlife, marine science, wildlife, animal science, evolution paleontology, oceanology, biology science, scientific biology, and museum exhibitions promotional, advertising, documentary, educational, or marketing projects.

The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2022 and rendered with V-Ray. Renders have no postprocessing!Hope you like it!

  - High quality polygonal model, has real dimensions. Easy to merge into your scene.

  - Units: feet w/fractional inches

  - The model was created with the optimal number of polygons. (The Turbosmooth modifier is assigned to the original mesh. Easy to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All the objects come with complete UVs

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped. (All colors can be easily modified.)

  - All objects are attached for ease of objects selection and scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary (Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.) - just drop model into your scene.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

description_text:
Laboratory Equipment
This package contains essential elements to represent a well-equipped laboratory. The models are designed with a low polygon count making it easy to include them in more complex scenes. You will find five large groups: Lab glassware, lab metal equipment, laboratory plasticware, lab disposable and laboratory countertop. These groups contain the following objects:
Lab glassware:
• Test tubes: Test tube x 19, biochemistry red test tube, biochemistry yellow test tube, hematology blue test tube and hematology test tube. • Beaker 500 and 1000ml.• Burette 10ml.• Cover slip x 4. • Crucible x 2. • Erlenmeyer flask 250 and 1000ml. • Funnel. • Glass container. • Glass slide x 4. • Glass stirring rod.• Measuring cylinder 250 and 1000ml.• Morter. • Petri dish x 4. • Pipette 5, 10 and 20ml. • Porcelain capsule.• Thermometer -10 a 110°C. • Volumetric flask 500ml.• Watch glass.
lab metal equipment:
• Bunsen burner.• Crucible tongs.• Gauze mat.• Iris forceps.• Iron support ring.• Retort stand.• Spatula.• Test tube rack.• Tripod.
laboratory plasticware:
• Dropper x 2. • Propipette.• Red fluid x 4. 
lab disposable:
  - Circular filter paper x 3. 
Laboratory countertop:
• Countertop.• Drawer x 15.• Handle x 17.• Door x 2. • Overtable. 
Total Items: 125Total vertices: 61,102Total Edges: 18,686Total faces: 59,706Total tris: 120,544
Note: The drawers and doors of the countertop are fully designed, so they can be moved at will. Volumetric and measurement objects have true scales.
This package has two versions, an English version and a Spanish version to facilitate the use of the models in both languages. You will get the models in the .glb, .FBX and .blend formats, as well as the corresponding textures. The original file is in .blend, so care must be taken when configuring materials in other software. Most 3D software will recognize model materials without any problems, however, setting the materials in other software than Blender is up to you.
Materiales de laboratorio

description_text:
KAWS is a contemporary art and design brand founded by Brian Donnelly in the late 1990s. Brian Donnelly began his career as a graffiti artist in the early 1990s before he started to create and develop his iconic KAWS characters that would eventually become central to his eponymous brand. The brand began with a focus on producing toys and art pieces that quickly became collectible items, and it has since expanded to include clothing, accessories, and footwear.
The brand's signature aesthetic is characterized by bold, bright colors, and playful designs. The designs often incorporate classic pop culture references and iconic KAWS characters that are instantly recognizable by fans across the world. One of the most notable and well-known products by KAWS is the Companion Open Edition Vinyl Figure.
What makes KAWS different from other brands is its ability to merge the line between art and fashion. It has been able to combine the fine art world and the commercial world, and ultimately, its products have garnered respect from both audiences. Its collaborations with fashion brands have added to the excitement of the brand, producing unique and innovative releases like the Nike Air Max 90 Kaws White Volt. Additionally, many brand products are designed with an attention to detail that can only be found in a true artisan's work.
KAWS' merchandise can be paired and worn in many ways. Clothing and accessories bearing KAWS' signature designs can be mixed and matched to create a trendy look. The brand's sculptures can be displayed at home and instantly become a conversation starter while admiring their intricate details and designs.

The edge of the umbrella shaped body has some whisker like tentacles, some of which can be as long as 20-30 meters.The main component of a jellyfish's body is water, which is composed of two germ layers: the inner and outer layers. There is a thick middle layer between the two layers, which is not only transparent but also has a floating effect. When they are in motion, they use the reflection of water spray inside their bodies to move forward. From a distance, they look like circular umbrellas rapidly drifting in the water; Some jellyfish have umbrella shaped bodies with various patterns, and in the blue ocean, these swimming jellyfish of different colors appear very beautiful.They can be found in tropical waters, temperate waters, shallow waters, oceans about 100 meters deep, and even freshwater areas. Jellyfish existed as early as 650 million years ago, even before dinosaurs. There are over 250 species of jellyfish in water bodies around the world, distributed throughout the globe. All living in the ocean.Model making software: 3ds Max 2014 Rendering software: vray3.60.03 for 3dmax2014Animation: 3dsmax 2014 Point Cache animation (1100 frame animation effect)Note: The background is an image material rather than a 3D model. Based on the Watson-Crick DNA model (B-form double helix), with options for A-form or Z-form configurations.
Includes precisely positioned sugar-phosphate backbones and correctly paired nitrogenous bases (adenine-thymine, cytosine-guanine) with hydrogen bond detailing.
Optional histone proteins and nucleosome units for chromatin or eukaryotic DNA modeling.
  - Source Options
High-resolution 3D scan of laboratory-grade physical models (if scanned from a reference).
Procedurally generated digital model (parametric design allowing for base pair adjustments, helix pitch, and strand length modifications).

Watertight, manifold mesh (no holes or non-printable geometry errors).
Variable LOD (Level of Detail) – Simplified for FDM printing or highly detailed for resin/SLA printing.
Pre-supported versions available for trouble-free resin 3D printing.
Scalable dimensions (from nanoscale simulation to macroscopic educational models).

Sci-Fi & Game Design – High-tech props, futuristic holograms.
Preview Renders
Sample images rendered in KeyShot for photorealistic accuracy.
Customization Options
Adjustable helix twist, base pair count, and supercoiling.
Optional UV unwrapping & PBR textures for realistic rendering.

This Glycogen Molecule 3D model represents the multibranched polysaccharide that serves as the primary storage form of glucose in animals and humans. Found mainly in the liver and muscle tissues, glycogen is broken down to release glucose when energy is required. Structurally, glycogen consists of long chains of glucose units linked by a(1?4) glycosidic bonds, with branching points formed by a(1?6) linkages. This 3D molecular model is perfect for educational visualization, biochemical research, medical training, and metabolic studies.
The model is ready for close up renderingsThe model is created in Maya software.The model is in 0,0,0, in the X/Y/Z position.Model is in scale and rotation set to 1,1,1 and 0,0,0 .No Photoshop or compositing used, the Product is ready to render. description_text:
The Ethereal Remains 3D model is a hauntingly beautiful digital sculpture that merges dark fantasy, gothic horror, and supernatural mystery into one unforgettable centerpiece. This model captures the spectral essence of an ancient being—half skeletal, half demonic—who lingers between the worlds of the living and the dead. Perfect for horror games, dark fantasy RPGs, cinematic cutscenes, or collectible 3D printing, the Ethereal Remains instantly infuses any scene with atmosphere, dread, and timeless power.
This design showcases meticulous sculptural detail. The figure’s gaunt, skeletal torso and hollow chest cavities evoke centuries of decay, while the textured surface reveals cracks, scars, and intricate bone-like patterns that seem etched by time itself. Its elongated skull and pronounced cheekbones are crowned with twisting, ridged horns that curl upward like ancient, petrified roots or infernal crowns. The partially closed eyes and skeletal grin create a complex expression—one of serene immortality and eerie menace—inviting speculation about whether the being is at peace or poised to awaken.
Technically, the Ethereal Remains is production-ready and optimized for a wide range of 3D workflows. The model’s clean, low-poly topology ensures seamless integration into Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, Maya, and 3ds Max, while supporting high-resolution renders and close-up cinematic shots. All UVs are precisely unwrapped for 4K PBR textures, including Base Color, Normal, Roughness, and Ambient Occlusion maps. These textures highlight every ridge, cavity, and weathered surface, responding realistically to different lighting—from moonlit crypts and arcane temples to dramatic stage spotlights.
The creative applications of this model are endless. In a dark fantasy RPG, the Ethereal Remains can be the spectral guardian of forbidden knowledge, the skeletal form of an ancient demon-lord, or a cursed soul bound to a necromantic artifact. In horror games and films, it becomes a terrifying apparition in haunted catacombs or the central figure of an occult ritual. It also serves as a collector’s showpiece or NFT artwork, appealing to enthusiasts of gothic and supernatural design. Its dramatic silhouette and intricate detailing make it equally at home as a museum-quality 3D print or as a cinematic focal point in high-end visual storytelling.
Beyond its visual presence, the Ethereal Remains carries deep symbolic resonance. The fusion of skeletal anatomy with demonic horns suggests themes of eternal punishment, forbidden transformation, and the thin boundary between spirit and flesh. It speaks to myths of immortality and cosmic judgment, making it more than a mere monster—it becomes a representation of the unseen forces that shape destiny and death.
In summary, the Ethereal Remains 3D model is a masterpiece of digital dark art—an unforgettable fusion of horror and elegance. With its intricate sculpting, game-ready optimization, and limitless narrative potential, it enriches any project that seeks to evoke the supernatural. Whether showcased in a haunted temple, guarding the entrance to a necromancer’s lair, or displayed as a striking 3D collectible, it will captivate and unsettle viewers in equal measure.

description_text:
The Alien Reptile Sentinel stands as a chilling testament to evolutionary paths untouched by Earth’s influence, a creature born from the hostile environments of distant star systems where survival demands adaptation beyond human comprehension. Its physique blends reptilian structure with alien biomechanical traits, forming a predatory silhouette that conveys both primal instinct and engineered purpose. The elongated skull, devoid of familiar facial features, suggests a species that relies on heightened sensory perception rather than sight alone, allowing it to track prey through vibrations, electromagnetic signatures, or heat patterns emitted by living beings.
The creature's exoskeletal ridges, arranged like spines along its back, serve not only as natural armor but as sensory conduits or energy regulators, hinting at a biological defense system capable of absorbing or emitting radiation. Their golden tones contrast with the creature’s cold, bluish skin, creating an eerie visual dynamic that reinforces its otherworldly origin. Each ridge seems to pulse with dormant power, suggesting that the sentinel may activate unique defensive or offensive capabilities when threatened. Its limbs, jointed in unsettling ways, enable both quadrupedal stability and sudden bipedal bursts, allowing it to traverse alien terrain with uncanny agility.
The creature’s claws, sharp and curved, speak to its predatory efficiency. Whether guarding ancient ruins, patrolling alien research facilities, or lurking within shadowed caverns of forgotten planets, the Alien Reptile Sentinel embodies relentless vigilance. Its presence implies a society—or creator—that values control and protection over territory or technology. Some legends within sci-fi lore envision sentinels like this as guardians of quarantined ecosystems, biological security systems developed by ancient civilizations to ensure that dangerous knowledge or species remain contained.
This 3D model excels in science fiction environments, extraterrestrial ecosystems, horror-infused space settings, and narrative-driven worlds involving alien experimentation, crashed ships, or unknown planets. It can function as a formidable enemy, mysterious guardian, or neutral territorial creature shaped by millennia of evolution. Artists, game developers, and world-builders will find the design evocative, blending the familiar aspects of reptilian biology with unnerving alien morphology that sparks imagination and storytelling potential.
The Alien Reptile Sentinel enriches visual storytelling with its hybrid aesthetic and thematic depth, serving as a powerful representation of the unknown dangers waiting beyond the stars.

description_text:
Blight Growth is a disturbing and highly detailed organic 3D asset designed to embody corruption, decay, and unnatural evolution. This model represents a malignant growth born from cursed soil, toxic magic, alien infestation, or biological catastrophe. Its swollen, bulbous surface forms are layered with fleshy masses that pulse visually with sickness and instability, while vine-like tendrils and root structures bind the growth together, anchoring it to the ground like a parasitic organism feeding on the land itself.
The sculpt emphasizes asymmetry and organic chaos, making the asset feel alive, uncomfortable, and unpredictable. Each lumpy form appears to strain against the others, as though the blight is continuously expanding, mutating, and consuming whatever lies beneath it. Vein-like structures wrap around the surface, suggesting circulation, infection, or arcane energy flowing through the mass. These details make the model ideal for horror, dark fantasy, sci-fi, or post-apocalyptic environments where visual storytelling relies on unsettling shapes and textures.
Blight Growth functions exceptionally well as an environmental storytelling prop. It can be placed in corrupted forests, plague-ridden dungeons, alien biomes, underground caverns, or ritual sites to instantly communicate danger and contamination. The asset may serve as a passive environmental hazard, a resource node, a spawn point for enemies, or even the dormant stage of a larger boss creature. Its ambiguous form allows developers and artists to adapt it to a wide variety of narrative roles without redesign.
From a technical perspective, the model is built with clean topology and optimized geometry suitable for real-time rendering. The PBR material setup ensures realistic surface response, balancing moist organic sheen with matte diseased flesh. Subtle color variation across the surface prevents visual flatness and enhances realism, especially under dynamic lighting. The grounded base and root-like extensions help the asset blend naturally into terrain meshes, avoiding the floating or disconnected look common in lesser-quality props.
This asset is particularly valuable for game developers working on horror survival games, dark RPGs, dungeon crawlers, sci-fi infestations, or fantasy worlds plagued by corruption. It is equally useful for cinematic renders, concept art scenes, and promotional visuals where atmosphere and emotional impact are essential. The grotesque aesthetic immediately captures attention and communicates threat without the need for animation or sound.
Whether used as a cursed landmark, a biological anomaly, or a visual metaphor for spreading evil, Blight Growth adds depth, tension, and narrative weight to any scene. It is not merely a prop, but a storytelling device—one that suggests history, consequence, and an unseen force actively reshaping the world around it.

The female pelvis is a specialized version of the pelvic girdle, specifically adapted to facilitate childbirth (parturition). This morphology is essential for creating a sufficiently large passage (the birth canal) through which a baby can pass during delivery.

Subpubic Angle (Pubic Arch): Is wider (generally 80-90 degrees or more), creating a broader outlet.
Ischial Tuberosities: Are turned further apart, contributing to the wider outlet.

description_text:
The Metatron's Cube is a 2D geometric pattern created from 13 equal circles.  Two layers of 6 circles in a hexagon pattern radiating from the central circle. Metatron's Cube shares similarities with the Flower of Life and is a sacred geometric figure with symbolic meaning.
This design is sized as a pendant to be worn around the neck. Any chain or necklace should fit through one of the 6 outer circles which will allow the pendant to sit in the correct position.
Size of the pendant is approximately 50mm in diameter, about 2 inches. File includes 6x different models. Happy to scale the product as required. Product is designed in Rhino 3D and exported into STL, OBJ, 3DS file formats.

description_text:
A car (or automobile) is a wheeled motor vehicle used for transportation. Most definitions of car say they run primarily on roads, seat one to eight people, have four tires, and mainly transport people rather than goods.[2][3]
Cars came into global use during the 20th century, and developed economies depend on them. The year 1886 is regarded as the birth year of the modern car when German inventor Karl Benz patented his Benz Patent-Motorwagen. Cars became widely available in the early 20th century. One of the first cars accessible to the masses was the 1908 Model T, an American car manufactured by the Ford Motor Company. Cars were rapidly adopted in the US, where they replaced animal-drawn carriages and carts, but took much longer to be accepted in Western Europe and other parts of the world.
Cars have controls for driving, parking, passenger comfort, and a variety of lights. Over the decades, additional features and controls have been added to vehicles, making them progressively more complex. These include rear reversing cameras, air conditioning, navigation systems, and in-car entertainment. Most cars in use in the 2010s are propelled by an internal combustion engine, fueled by the combustion of fossil fuels. Electric cars, which were invented early in the history of the car, began to become commercially available in 2008.
There are costs and benefits to car use. The costs to the individual include acquiring the vehicle, interest payments (if the car is financed), repairs and maintenance, fuel, depreciation, driving time, parking fees, taxes, and insurance.[4] The costs to society include maintaining roads, land use, road congestion, air pollution, public health, health care, and disposing of the vehicle at the end of its life. Road traffic accidents are the largest cause of injury-related deaths worldwide.[5]
The personal benefits include on-demand transportation, mobility, independence, and convenience.[6] The societal benefits include economic benefits, such as job and wealth creation from the automotive industry, transportation provision, societal well-being from leisure and travel opportunities, and revenue generation from the taxes. People's ability to move flexibly from place to place has far-reaching implications for the nature of societies.[7] There are around 1 billion cars in use worldwide. The numbers are increasing rapidly, especially in China, India and other newly industrialized countries

Abacus Vintage Set ( Collection ) – Mid Poly.
Bring life to your scenes with this stylized yet realistic model, optimized for games, VR/AR experiences, and architectural visualization.
Model Specifications:
Polygon Count: 21,172 Faces / 21,190 Vertices (no subdivision).
Objects in Scene: 3
UVs: Clean, non-overlapping.
Textures: 4K (4096x4096), including:
Base Color (Albedo). / Metallic. / Roughness. / Normal. / Height.
Software Used:
Modeled in Blender ( version 3.3.20 ).
Textured in Substance Painter.
Rendered with Cycles.
Included File Formats: .blend (native) / .fbx / .obj / .stl / .glb / .dae /
All textures neatly organized in a TEXTURES folder for easy access.
Key Features:
Game-ready, low poly model – optimized for real-time rendering.
High-quality PBR textures with realistic details.
Perfect topology for both close-up renders and efficient scene performance.
Easy to customize colors and materials.
Well-named objects and materials for quick scene setup.
Usage Recommendations: Ideal for:
Game environments. / Animation scenes. / VR/AR apps.
Stylized or realistic architectural projects.
Note: This model is not pre-optimized for 3D printing, but can be adjusted if needed.
Don’t forget to check out my profile for more game-ready assets. Your support helps me create more high-quality models — thank you!

description_text:
Baroque Pavé Luxury — Production-Ready CAD Model for JewelersSome designs whisper.This one speaks in heritage and brilliance.
The Fleur de Lis Diamond Key Pendant Necklace 3D jewelry model merges the regal authority of the fleur-de-lis with flowing baroque scrollwork. It is not merely decorative. It is architectural.
Designed specifically for jewelry manufacturers and CAD-driven designers, this model eliminates the most time-consuming stage of custom production: rebuilding complex symmetry and pavé distribution from zero.
You receive geometry that’s already disciplined.
Design Language: French Baroque Meets Modern PavéThe key head forms a three-petal fleur-de-lis, each petal sculpted in elegant S-curved scroll lines. The interior remains openwork, creating strong negative space contrast against the pavé diamond borders.
Below the head:
A single-section thick cylindrical key shaft
Six vertical rows of pavé diamonds
Smooth metal separator rings for structural reinforcement
An “F”-shaped baroque key tooth, fully pavé set
The aesthetic blends 17th–18th century French court ornamentation with contemporary diamond saturation. It is refined—but visually powerful.
Dimensions & WearabilitySpecification   MeasurementTotal Height    54.63 mm (≈ 5.5 cm)Maximum Width   20.48 mm (≈ 2.0 cm)Thickness   4.22 mmAt 5.5 cm tall, this is the tallest design in the key series.Despite its height, the 4.22 mm slim profile ensures elegant drape and balanced weight when worn on medium to heavy chains.
The tapered pavé bail aligns proportionally with the elongated silhouette, eliminating the need for resizing adjustments during production.
Diamond Configuration & Carat ConversionTotal Stones: 186 round brilliant diamonds
Stone Size  Quantity    Approx. Carat (Each)    Estimated Total1.0 mm  136 pcs ≈ 0.005 ct    ~0.68 ct0.9 mm  50 pcs  ≈ 0.003 ct    ~0.15 ctEstimated Total Carat Weight            ~0.83 ct(Original reference total: 0.694 ct. Based on calibrated round brilliant conversion tables, production yield typically approaches ~0.80–0.85 ct depending on depth ratio.)
Pavé Structure1.0 mm stones define petal borders, central core, and full shaft coverage
0.9 mm stones refine scroll edges and curved transitions
Openwork scroll interiors framed with polished metal lines for depth contrast
Symmetrical drill map optimized for micro-pavé setting accuracy
This layout ensures efficient stone seat drilling and consistent spacing tolerance.
Included File Formats
3DM (Rhino-compatible)
STL (casting/printing ready)
Meshes are watertight. Surfaces are clean. Undercuts are controlled for reliable casting flow.
Why This Model Matters to Your WorkshopCustom CAD on a design like this requires:
Reconstructing mirrored scroll symmetry
Calibrating 180+ micro-stone placements
Adjusting pavé spacing along curved S-lines
Reinforcing openwork structures for casting integrity
That’s not creative work.That’s time leakage.
With this Fleur de Lis Diamond Key Pendant Necklace model, the structural math is already solved. You move directly to production—casting, setting, finishing.
Less CAD friction. More finished pieces.

description_text:
OverviewBring your educational, architectural, or narrative projects to life with this highly detailed, Cinematic PBR Classroom Environment. Designed with realistic proportions and atmospheric lighting, this scene is perfect for animations, renders, and game development.
Original Creator's Note This scene was originally conceptualized and built entirely in Blender. While it has been carefully converted and optimized for other major software (Cinema 4D, Maya, and 3ds Max) with their respective render engines, we highly recommend opening the native .blend file for the absolute best out-of-the-box visual experience, original node setups, and lighting fidelity.
Key Features
High-Quality PBR Textures: Includes Diffuse, Normal, Roughness, and Opacity maps for realistic material behavior.
Cinematic Lighting: Pre-lit with beautiful, atmospheric sunlight and window god-rays (volumetrics setup included in the native file).
Highly Detailed Props: Includes classic wooden student desks, chairs, a detailed blackboard with math equations, a teacher's desk, wall maps, and window blinds.
Ready to Render: Optimized render setups for various engines.
Included Formats
Blender (.blend) - Native & Highly Recommended (Cycles/Eevee)
Cinema 4D (.c4d) - Redshift Ready
Maya (.ma / .mb) - Arnold Ready
3ds Max (.max) - V-Ray Ready
Universal: .FBX and .OBJ (with texture folders)
PolycountOptimized for smooth viewport performance while maintaining high-end render quality.
Support & Contact Your satisfaction is my priority! If you encounter any issues with the models, missing textures, or need help setting up the scene in your specific software, please don't hesitate to reach out. You can directly DM me on Instagram at [@Sivixgamer] for quick support and troubleshooting.

description_text:
The moon has been an object of amazement since the beginning of time. The Stonehenge and the Pyramids were build around the sun, moon, and stars. Now you can add it to your very own Stonehenge or Pyramid. Or perhaps you will plunge back into history and make your very own monolith lost to the modern world. What ever you decide to create, from an ancient monument to a modern home, the moon will add realism and natural light to your render.
This moon is made to the highest standards. It includes two separate shaders. One of the shaders is for showing the moon from the earth like the image above. The other shader is for making renders of the earth from space. Why make two different shaders? Well when you look at the moon from the earth to see the light of the moon through the atmosphere of the earth which varies the color of the moon and the haze. Not only this but also the moon's phases, which are caused by the sun's light hitting only one side of the moon, would not work when displaying the moon in a landscape. Imagine you had a night scene like the one above and you wanted to make the moon a half moon. You would then add in a sun lamp and position it so that the light only hits one side of the moon. You go to render it and the whole scene is completely lit because of the sun lamp. This problem is solved with my separate shader which emits light in only certain areas on the moon.
Also this moon has the option to change color so you can make a apocalyptic red moon or a rare strawberry moon. This detail expands your possible applications and thus your creativity.
Product Details
4K Image textures including the moon phases4K Bump MapVolumetric Moon hazeTwo different shaders, one for the moon from the earth and one for the moon from space.The ability to change the moon's color and brightness. 
If you have any questions just ask!Thanks for browsing!

description_text:
3d-printable Sierpinski Fractal Pyramid - 3d nested triangle / tetrahedron / pyramid shape - with smooth corners
produced with a signed distance function / marching cubes process followed by quadratic decimation.
includes higher-poly version with 865K faces and lower-poly version with 432K faces.
binary stl, ply, obj formats
The Sierpinski Fractal Pyramid is a three-dimensional fractal shape derived from the Sierpinski triangle, a well-known fractal in two dimensions. It is constructed by recursively removing smaller pyramidal sections from a larger pyramid, resulting in a self-replicating, intricate structure.
3D printing a Sierpinski Fractal Pyramid can be challenging due to several factors:
Complexity: The pyramid's recursive nature results in a high level of geometric intricacy, with numerous smaller pyramidal voids within larger ones. This complexity can lead to difficulties in maintaining structural integrity during the printing process.
Precision: Achieving the desired level of detail and accuracy in each layer of the pyramid can be demanding. Printers need to be finely tuned, and the printing material should be of high quality to prevent issues like warping or layer misalignment.
Supports and Overhangs: As the pyramid's layers get smaller and narrower, overhangs and unsupported areas become more prominent. Adequate support structures need to be designed and printed to ensure the model's stability and prevent print failures.
Printing Time: Printing a Sierpinski Fractal Pyramid, especially at a high level of detail, can be time-consuming. The intricate structure requires many layers to be printed, which may extend the printing time significantly.
Post-Processing: Removing support structures, sanding, and finishing the 3D-printed pyramid to achieve a smooth and polished appearance can be labor-intensive and time-consuming due to its intricate design.

This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built  3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This scan was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher within Zbrush.
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a surgical nurse. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of  architectural visualizations, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc.

Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world.  We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

At first glance, the limb appears macabre—an exposed, natural bone structure stretching upward like a relic resurrected from the past. Yet the bones are reinforced, stabilized by sleek metallic braces and connected through vibrant blue cables that pulse like artificial veins. This delicate interplay between organic form and engineered precision creates a visual narrative of a limb caught between life and machine.
The lower half transitions fully into cybernetic architecture. Intricate mechanical joints, hydraulic pistons, and reinforced plates form a futuristic foot built for rugged environments and enhanced performance. Every gear, bolt, and metallic contour is crafted to suggest durability and power, transforming what would be a vulnerable skeletal appendage into a formidable asset capable of adapting to hostile terrain or high-intensity movement.
The limb could belong to a cyber-enhanced creature, a reanimated construct, or a post-apocalyptic survivor outfitted with improvised tech to restore lost mobility. It hints at a world where technology has learned to merge seamlessly with the remnants of biological forms—a world where bones, wires, and steel coexist as one. Whether used as a collectible item, character upgrade, or environmental storytelling prop, the Bone-Strider captures a unique blend of horror, sci-fi, and mechanical artistry.

Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...

I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Hello everyone,
In this personal work, I modeled a male skull for you. I used blender, zbrush and substance programs in this study, which I did by trying to stick to the anatomical details. I preferred marmoset for the rendering phase. I covered it with two different textures, dirty and clean. You can use or print the model, which consists of two parts, the upper and lower parts, either separately or as a single piece. It is ready for use in games, rendering and printing.

description_text:
Model
Single object. 2,098 tris. Simple bone armature compatible with Mixamo.
Materials
Single material for entire characters suit.
Textures
PBR metallic roughness textures. 4096px resolution.
A hazmat suit (hazardous materials suit) is a piece of personal protective equipment that consists of an impermeable whole-body garment worn as protection against hazardous materials. Such suits are often combined with self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) to ensure a supply of breathable air. Hazmat suits are used by firefighters, emergency medical technicians, paramedics, researchers, personnel responding to toxic spills, specialists cleaning up contaminated facilities, and workers in toxic environments.

description_text:
A group of hikers discovered an abandoned bunker in Eastern Europe, from which they were able to extract these six objects that appear to come from a biological testing laboratory. I assume that the objects were exposed to some kind of corrosive compound, possibly as a consequence of the biological contents they once held. Residues can be observed adhered to the surface, and extreme caution is advised due to the high levels of radiation detected by my dosimeter.
DETAILS AND FEATURES
This set was carefully developed over the course of one month to be used in both render engines: Cycles and Eevee.
Each version is independent for technical reasons: the Cycles version is fully procedural, while for Eevee I combined baked textures with a few simple nodes that provide a solution for transparency, allowing glass-over-glass visibility and even seeing objects behind multiple layers of glass.
In both versions, the user is free to modify several useful parameters such as textures, surface bump depth, and radiation intensity (which can be completely disabled by setting the value to 0, if desired or required), among others.
In Cycles, being fully procedural, the user also has the freedom to vary colors, scale, distribution, and even the shape of the texture that generates dirt and biological material, as well as the wear on the glass surface. Essentially, you can create your own version according to your taste and narrative requirements. Additionally, since the materials are procedural, they can be swapped between objects.
All these customizable values (in both versions) are conveniently exposed in the Material tab of each object, allowing quick access without the need to interact with the Shader Editor nodes, saving production time.

FORMATS, FILES AND COMPATIBILITY
Inside the ZIP file you will find three folders:

  - EXPORT contains FBX, OBJ, MTL, GLB, and USDC files
