description_text:
This is a highly detailed model of a Sharp 'ELSIMATE' EL-8151 portable printing calculator from 1976. This device was notable for its use of an in-built 'Spark Printer' which printed by dragging a comb of electrodes across the surface of an aluminized carbon paper, burning off the aluminum coating in a dot-matrix pattern to expose the black paper underneath. It had a Vacuum Fluorescent Display, and could operate on built-in NI-CD batteries or on a wall power supply. 
This model is detailed enough for close up shots, and would make excellent set-decoration in any vintage setting. Textures and materials lifted from a real counterpart are included.

description_text:
Three rods and several disks of varying sizes that may be slid onto any rod make up the Tower of Hanoi, a well-known mathematics puzzle. The smallest disk is at the top of the problem, and the largest disk is at the bottom, with the disks piled in increasing size on a single rod. 
The puzzle's goal is to transfer the full stack to a different rod while adhering to the following guidelines:

  - You can only move one disk at a time.

  - In order to make a move, you must remove the topmost disk from a stack and place it on top of the stack either on an empty rod or another rod.

  - A smaller disk cannot be stacked on top of another disk. This rule guarantees that on any rod, the disks are always arranged from top to bottom in decreasing order.

Usually, the puzzle begins with the setup shown below:The A, B, and C rods are three.4 disks total on a source rod (B), where 4 is the number of disks.An additional rod (A) suitable for short-term storage.The rod (C) that you wish to shift the full stack to is the target.The goal is to transfer every disk from the source rod (B) to the destination rod (C) while adhering to the previously stated guidelines and utilizing the auxiliary rod (A) when necessary.
It has 0.25 mm tolerance for 3D printing. It has STL files and 3mf files you can 3d print it with different colored filaments if you need.

Nothing competes. Everything contributes.

description_text:
These files are the Fusion 360 source files of this project.
This is a very detailed model of a cnc milling machine. It's modelled after an existing milling machine that I had to overhaul for my final test in high school (see last picture). I used this model to create an animation of the tasks it had to do. It's controlled by a Siemens PLC S7-300 CPU314C-2 PN/DP DC DC DC . The machine has 1 automatic cycle and can also be manually controlled by the control panel on the right side.

description_text:
These files are the Fusion 360 source files of this project.
This bionic hand is controlled by an arduino nano V3. It uses 4 15kg servo's to move the index, middel, ring and little finger and 3 9g servo's to rotate the thumb and pull the tumb and the fingers open. This bionic hand it's structure is modelled after my hand so I could make a gel10 mold that would fit snug around it. The fingers are modelled in a way so they represent human bones as close as possible while remaining their functionality. This model is fully 3D printable.

Files included are High res JPG and sketchup files in higher and lower versions (2003, 2007, 2017, 2021). The files are free from any protection/encryption. The render settings are easy to follow and reuse. No special plugin needed to open the scene.

A few materials have been used and effect files are included. This realistic Lowpoly cross sectional soil profile 3d diagram is easy to reuse and can be used as a study material for Science teachers and students. The 3d files are clean and well grouped.

Files included are High res JPG and sketchup files in higher and lower versions (2003, 2007, 2017, 2021). The files are free from any protection/encryption. The render settings are easy to follow and reuse. No special plugin needed to open the scene.

description_text:
A simple and straightforward setup, creating a wave visualization utilizing the principle of the Fourier-series. The number of circles, and the path they draw is adjustable. 
The files were created for Blender 3.6X.
Video demos at https://www.instagram.com/codesign_projects
NOTE
-(Since it is a concept demonstration, it is kept as simple as possible.) The GeoNodes trees are kept clean, the nodes are not contracted into node groups for easier readability and have detailed explanations. You can embellish, refine as you wish.
-(The files are working in the Simulation Nodes branch. (Link included. Simply download that Blender and open the setup in it.) The reason for this is, that, since the effect is essentially a simulation, it is simpler to use in the Simulation Nodes branch, where you dont need a Buffer object to store the state of the simulation, like in the current official version. SimNodes will be included there soon anyway)

description_text:
Microscope toy 3D Model. 2 individual objects (plastic, lenses), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 11637 vertices, 11129 quad faces (22258 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
4 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 102589 vertices, 102325 quad faces (204650 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

description_text:
Eosinophilic granulocytes, usually called eosinophils (or, less commonly, acidophils), are cells of the immune system responsible for action against multicellular parasites and certain infections in vertebrates. Along with mast cells, they also control mechanisms associated with allergy and asthma. They develop in the bone marrow (hematopoiesis) before migrating to the peripheral blood.
Such cells are eosinophilic (have acid affinity) - usually transparent, appear brick-red after staining with eosin, a red and acidic dye. The staining is concentrated in small granules in the cellular cytoplasm, which contain various chemical mediators, such as histamine and proteins such as eosinophil peroxidase, ribonuclease (RNase), deoxyribonucleases, lipase, plasminogen, and the major basic protein. These mediators are released by a process called degranulation after activation of the eosinophil, and are toxic to the tissues of the parasite and host.
In normal eosinophilic individuals constitute about 1-6% of white blood cells, and are about 12-17 micrometers in size. In normal conditions are found in the bone marrow, at the junction between the cortex and thymus medulla, gastrointestinal tract, ovary, uterus, spleen and lymph nodes, but not in organs such as lung, skin and esophagus. The presence of eosinophils in the latter of these organs is associated with some diseases. Eosinophils persist in circulation for 8-12 hours, and can survive in tissues for an additional 8-12 days in the absence of stimulation.

Telescope optics parts 3D Models. 7 individual objects (12mm case, 25mm case, erecting prism case, extender, 12mm glass, 25mm glass, erecting prism glass), sharing 2 non overlapping UV Layout maps, Materials (opaque, glasses) and PBR Textures sets. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
7 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 13470 vertices, 13104 quad faces (26208 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!
